_comment: Channels surfaced in the Pyaar Radio app's Channels tab. A channel is any YT Music playlist you want to browse/explore (to add songs to Liked or other playlists). synced:true channels have their playlist auto-maintained by the sources framework (sources/sources.json, keyed by `source`); synced:false channels are playlists you already made and curate yourself. Add a row to register a new channel.
